I sat down with Nathan to break down his surprisingly simple trailer rental business. He runs it alongside a full-time job, spends only a few hours a week on it, and is now making around $4,000 a month in profit. We talked about how he bought his first trailers, automated almost the entire rental process, finds customers through Google and Facebook Marketplace, and which trailers he would buy first if he were starting over. We also get into how you can test demand in your own area before going all in.
